items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: I used to call Jerry Wexler. I'd get on my phone and call Jerry Wexler. Me and him talk just like we talk.

ctx.x: And then you went with Atlantic.

Right, okay. I had a, the success with Atlantic was, I had, I'm going to cross that river. Okay, that was a slow tune that was very, very successful for me. And even right now, I can go on the other side of the river and go up the river, go on to Edgar, Vashera, you know, round up that way. All I got to do is sing. I'm going to cross that river. See, I used to put two songs together. I'm going to cross that river and the things I used to do. That's all I had to do. Kill audience. Kill? Yes, indeed. And right now,…
Well, I want to get back to going to cross that river because you had some, who are you musicians on going to cross that river?
